findings.body: The allocate_ledger function changes the remaining threshold from > 0.01 to > 0.05 and the extra rate from 0.25 to 0.4. For remainders in the range (0.01, 0.05], the old code applies a 0.25 rate to the calculation sum, but the new code applies nothing, resulting in a lower total and under-allocation of funds.
findings.failure_scenario: When allocate_ledger processes a value where remaining is between 0.01 and 0.05 after bracket application, the old code adds (remaining * 0.25) to the sum but the new code omits this, producing a smaller final rounded value and causing under-allocation of funds.
findings.title: Fix allocate_ledger remaining threshold and rate
